statement: Uniform actual Gamma-module presentation of the wild relative kernel abelianization, with the source change and inverse, explicit matrix kernels for every graded wild Hom lattice, and the index-two local invariant comparison.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The source is the actual split local group D=Gal(Q3(zeta3)(3)/Q3(zeta3)) and its actual map to the free global P; the completed Fox row determines the displayed source isomorphism.
Left relation modules and right Fox ideals are distinguished by exact row and multiplication maps. The top involution is normalized by the explicit unit(1-w)/2.
Finite regular coefficients and natural local duality identify the right ideal exactly with ker(tau,tau-prime ->7); the inverse limit retains the right cyclotomic action.

A single actual source element r-star works for all A; evaluation identifies the extra lattice with ker((1-J)(T-7)). The numerical word for r-star depends on the actual Fox row and is not claimed evaluated.
The local cochain complex and both maps of its H2 comparison retain the degree-two restriction/corestriction factor: y maps to[y/2], inverse[x] maps to[(1-J)x].
Exact rational three-integral kernel bases and inverse coordinates are retained for degrees1–3; higher nonlinear relation values remain part of E23.
